customer: Moved to Corlan recently. Can I sell you my midsize SUV if it's still registered in my old state?
agent: Yes, per our article "Selling a car registered in another state," we buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live in a different one. Just bring the registration from the state that issued it. If the title has been lost, the duplicate title rules of the issuing state apply, which are covered in "Selling a paid-off car when the title is lost."
